# launchd - Ollama

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `launchd.ollama` |
| Source | `09_launchd/ollama.yaml` |
| Tags | launchd, ai |

Runs `ollama serve` under launchd, bound to 127.0.0.1:11434. Inherits the
common process posture and log layout from `launchd.base`.
